title: Project Workspace Boundary
summary: Define project ownership, membership, least-privilege roles and data isolation for the P0 Canonical Specification Core.

intent.statement: Ensure every P0 specification and governance record belongs to one project and can be accessed only by an authorised member of that project.
desired_outcomes: Project-scoped engineering artefacts are isolated from non-members and other projects.
P0 roles and ownership transitions are explicit, safe and auditable.

success_measures.name: Cross-project access denial
success_measures.target: 100% denial in the automated security suite
success_measures.measurement_method: Execute every P0 read and mutation with a principal who is not a member of the resource project.

success_measures.name: Owner continuity
success_measures.target: 0 successful mutations that leave a project without an active Owner
success_measures.measurement_method: Run single-threaded and concurrent membership-revocation and ownership-transfer tests.

out_of_scope: Enterprise SSO, SCIM and group provisioning.

provenance.rationale: Finalised P0 child specification following approval of the Canonical Specification Core.

problem.statement: A specification governance platform cannot be trusted without a server-side project boundary that prevents unauthorised reads, writes and approvals.
problem.current_state: The project currently has a P0 role concept but no approved workspace authorisation contract, persistence model or ownership-continuity rule.
impact: Unauthorised access could disclose or alter engineering intent.
The platform could incorrectly attribute approvals or allow an ownerless project.
Future tenant-level governance would rest on an insecure project boundary.

business_context.business_value: A secure project boundary is a prerequisite for trustworthy specification ownership, auditability and later enterprise multi-tenancy.

stakeholders.name: Platform Engineering Team
stakeholders.role: Implements and operates P0 access controls

actors.name: Project Owner
goals: Manage members and approve project specifications.

actors.name: Project Editor
goals: Create, revise and validate engineering specifications.

actors.name: Workspace Authorisation Service
goals: Evaluate project membership and capability before every P0 action.

functional_requirements.title: Grant project membership
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall allow an active Owner to add a verified principal as an Owner, Editor or Viewer in the Owner's project.

functional_requirements.title: Enforce project-scoped authorisation
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall evaluate verified principal membership, role capability and the server-resolved target project before every P0 project-scoped query or command.

provenance.rationale: P0 tenant and project isolation requirement.

functional_requirements.title: Protect final active Owner
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall reject a membership revocation or role change that would remove or demote the final active Owner in a project.

functional_requirements.title: Transfer sole ownership safely
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall allow an active Owner to atomically transfer ownership to an active Editor in the same project by promoting the target and demoting the initiator.

provenance.rationale: Resolved open question for P0 scope.

functional_requirements.title: Audit membership and access decisions
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall append a structured audit event for every membership mutation and denied project-scoped command without storing secret or restricted request payloads.

functional_requirements.title: List authorised project memberships
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall allow an authorised project member to list active memberships for their project without exposing membership information from any other project.

non_functional_requirements.statement: The authorisation layer shall default-deny any P0 operation when verified project membership or the required capability is absent.
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Execute a complete Owner, Editor, Viewer, non-member and unauthenticated role matrix for every P0 endpoint.

non_functional_requirements.statement: Membership changes and ownership transfers shall use transactional consistency and optimistic concurrency to avoid lost updates or an ownerless project.
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Concurrent integration tests exercise revoke, demote and transfer requests against the same membership versions.
non_functional_requirements.target: No committed transaction violates the active-Owner invariant.

provenance.rationale: Ownership change must be safe under concurrency.

business_rules.statement: A Viewer may never create, alter, validate, approve or archive a specification revision.
An Editor may never approve, archive or manage membership.

provenance.rationale: Separation of authoring and approval responsibilities.

business_rules.statement: A membership mutation that removes or demotes the final active Owner must be rejected with LAST_OWNER_PROTECTED.
Ownership transfer requires an Owner initiator and an active Editor target in the same project and atomically promotes the target while demoting the initiator.
Project and tenant scope used in persistence queries must derive from verified identity context and server-side resource resolution, not a mutable client role or tenant field.

provenance.rationale: Defence in depth for tenant isolation.

constraints.statement: P0 roles are fixed to Owner, Editor and Viewer; custom roles and ABAC rules are not introduced in this release.
constraints.rationale: A small role model enables strong, comprehensively tested authorisation before enterprise policy complexity is added.

assumptions.statement: The upstream identity layer supplies a verified stable principal identifier and verified tenant context for every authenticated request.
assumptions.risk_if_false: Workspace authorisation cannot make a reliable principal-to-project decision.

dependencies.name: Verified identity context
dependencies.risk: The selected P0 application scaffold must expose verified principal identity to server-side API handlers.

bounded_contexts.name: Workspace Management
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Own project identity, active membership, role grants, ownership transfer and authorisation decisions.

bounded_contexts.name: Specification Management
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Own canonical specification revisions and invoke Workspace Management before each project-scoped command.

bounded_contexts.name: Audit and Evidence
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Persist append-only project-scoped audit events and evidence pointers.

ubiquitous_language.definition: The P0 isolation boundary for memberships, specifications, governance records and audit events.
A project-scoped role grant held by one verified principal.
A server-side permission needed to perform a specific P0 action.
An atomic role transition that promotes an active Editor and demotes the initiating Owner.

entities.name: Project
entities.description: The durable engineering workspace and isolation boundary.

entities.name: ProjectMembership
entities.description: An active or revoked project-scoped role grant.

workflows.name: Transfer sole project ownership
workflows.trigger: An active Owner requests operational handover.

steps.action: Submits an ownership-transfer request naming an active Editor and current membership versions.
Verifies initiator Owner capability and target project membership.
steps.result: Authorisation succeeds or returns a denial without mutation.

steps.action: Atomically promotes target to Owner and demotes initiator to Editor using optimistic concurrency checks.
steps.result: Project retains an active Owner and correlated audit event is appended.

outcomes: Ownership has moved without an ownerless state.
Both membership versions and the audit event are retrievable.
workflows.error_handling: A stale membership version produces a conflict; an invalid target or capability produces a policy error; neither outcome mutates state.

states.name: REVOKED
states.description: Membership no longer grants project access.

data_models.name: Authoritative workspace state
data_models.retention_policy: Active and revoked membership history and associated audit records follow organisation retention policy and are never rewritten.

security_requirements.statement: Every project-scoped API operation shall authenticate the principal and server-side authorise the requested capability against active membership in the resource project.
security_requirements.verification_method: Automated role matrix and two-project isolation tests for every endpoint.

security_requirements.statement: The service shall not disclose whether a resource exists outside the caller's project scope.
security_requirements.verification_method: Cross-project access tests assert a generic not-found or capability-denied response according to the published error policy.

observability_requirements.statement: Membership and authorisation operations shall emit structured audit events with request, project, actor, target, action, outcome and timestamp fields.
observability_requirements.verification_method: Integration tests inspect persisted events and verify sensitive data is absent.

acceptance_criteria.title: Owner grants Editor membership
acceptance_criteria.given: An active Owner and a verified principal who is not a member of the project.
acceptance_criteria.when: The Owner creates an Editor membership.
acceptance_criteria.then: A single active Editor membership exists and a MEMBERSHIP_GRANTED audit event is recorded.

acceptance_criteria.title: Editor cannot manage membership
acceptance_criteria.given: An active Editor in a project.
acceptance_criteria.when: The Editor attempts to create, change or revoke membership.
acceptance_criteria.then: The service returns CAPABILITY_DENIED, makes no change and audits the denial.

acceptance_criteria.title: Viewer is denied specification mutation
acceptance_criteria.given: A Viewer with an otherwise valid specification identifier.
acceptance_criteria.when: The Viewer requests draft creation, validation, revision or approval.
acceptance_criteria.then: The request is denied before any specification command runs.

acceptance_criteria.title: Cross-project access is denied
acceptance_criteria.given: A member of Project A and a resource belonging to Project B.
acceptance_criteria.when: The member reads or mutates the Project B resource.
acceptance_criteria.then: The service denies access without revealing the resource's existence.

acceptance_criteria.title: Final Owner is protected
acceptance_criteria.given: A project with exactly one active Owner.
acceptance_criteria.when: That Owner attempts to revoke or demote their membership.
acceptance_criteria.then: The command fails with LAST_OWNER_PROTECTED and membership state remains unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.title: Sole ownership transfers atomically
acceptance_criteria.given: An Owner and active Editor with current membership versions in the same project.
acceptance_criteria.then: The target becomes Owner, the initiator becomes Editor and both changes plus an audit event commit atomically.

acceptance_criteria.title: Audit records membership and denial outcomes
acceptance_criteria.given: A successful or denied membership operation.
acceptance_criteria.then: An append-only audit event contains project, actor, action, target, outcome, request ID and timestamp without secret data.

acceptance_criteria.title: Members see only their project membership list
acceptance_criteria.given: A Viewer in Project A and memberships in Projects A and B.
acceptance_criteria.when: The Viewer lists Project A memberships.
acceptance_criteria.then: Only Project A memberships are returned.

test_requirements.scope: Owner and Editor membership grant and management permissions.
test_requirements.expected_evidence: Role-matrix API test report and membership audit-event fixtures.

test_requirements.scope: Viewer, non-member and cross-project authorisation for all workspace and specification endpoints.
test_requirements.expected_evidence: Two-project denial test report with no state mutations or resource-existence disclosure.

test_requirements.scope: Last-Owner protection and ownership-transfer transactional concurrency.
test_requirements.expected_evidence: Concurrent mutation test results proving no committed ownerless state.

test_requirements.scope: Append-only membership and authorisation audit records.
test_requirements.expected_evidence: Audit event schema and redaction test report.

risks.title: Identity context does not provide stable verified principal identifiers
risks.description: The P0 authorisation service cannot safely evaluate membership if identity claims are not verified and stable.
risks.mitigation: Select and validate the P0 identity integration before implementing the API; fail closed if identity context is absent.

risks.title: Race condition breaks ownership continuity
risks.description: Concurrent membership updates could remove the final Owner without transactional safeguards.
risks.mitigation: Use transaction isolation, optimistic concurrency versions and integration tests covering conflicting mutations.

open_questions.question: Should a sole Owner be able to transfer ownership to another member?
open_questions.impact_if_unresolved: Membership API semantics and recovery behaviour would remain incomplete.
open_questions.resolution: Yes. An Owner may atomically promote an active Editor in the same project and demote themselves to Editor, preserving at least one active Owner.

architecture_decisions.title: Enforce P0 authorisation in a server-side Workspace Authorisation Service
architecture_decisions.context: UI visibility controls cannot provide a security boundary, and every P0 artefact must be project-scoped.
architecture_decisions.decision: Resolve verified identity, resource project and active membership on the server for each P0 command and query; map Owner, Editor and Viewer to a fixed capability matrix.

alternatives.name: Client-side role enforcement
alternatives.rejection_reason: Client controls can be bypassed and do not protect APIs or data queries.

alternatives.name: ABAC in P0
alternatives.summary: Use dynamic attributes and policy engine from the first release.
alternatives.rejection_reason: Exceeds P0 scope and prevents a small exhaustive security test matrix.

architecture_decisions.rationale: The fixed server-side role model produces a simple, auditable and testable P0 boundary while preserving a later path to enterprise policies.
consequences: P0 must provide a stable verified principal context.
Custom roles and organisational policies are deferred.

architecture_decisions.title: Use atomic promote-and-demote ownership transfer
architecture_decisions.context: The project must allow a sole Owner to hand over responsibility without permitting an ownerless state.
architecture_decisions.decision: Ownership transfer is a single transaction that promotes an active Editor target to Owner and demotes the initiating Owner to Editor using optimistic concurrency checks.

alternatives.name: Revoke Owner before promoting target
alternatives.rejection_reason: Can leave the project ownerless if the second operation fails.

architecture_decisions.rationale: An atomic swap preserves continuity and produces one coherent audit trail.
consequences: The Workspace Command Service needs transactional storage and concurrency checks.

provenance.rationale: Implements the parent specification's project-scoped authorisation requirement.
